facts.fact: 换 Gerrick 视角：端水与炖汤走下黑暗监狱走廊送饭
facts.anchor: Gerrick’s footfalls were heavy as he made his way down the dark hallway.

facts.fact: 战后：怪物随 Vasara 之死全部逃逸去向不明——铁门被扯落"留到以后再想"
facts.anchor: The monsters had escaped after Vasara was killed. All of them, gone

facts.fact: Rayner 值守脸部重伤只睁一只眼——拒替班"我在这里为她"
facts.anchor: Rayner perked in the wooden chair. His face had been beaten so badly that Gerrick could only see one eye

facts.fact: Andra 被锁脏牢房：拒绝一切补给连毯子弃置——紫黑瘀伤不看他
facts.anchor: Andra sat against the far wall of the dingy cell they had locked her in the night before

facts.fact: 前夜 Gerrick 与 Nelveen 为昏迷的她清洗接骨包扎——每声骨响令他羞愤
facts.anchor: he and Nelveen had cleaned her while she remained unconscious, setting her broken bones and bandaging her lacerations.

facts.fact: 她终于转头看他——眼中生趣尽失只剩空洞："你真以为我会信你？"
facts.anchor: Where once was life and passion in those dark eyes he was so obsessed with, now lay nothing but emptiness.

facts.fact: 镣铐来历：Quentin 刑讯室找到——Nelveen 认出稀有魔法抑制器；锁住 Andra
facts.anchor: Quentin found the manacles in the torture chamber the night before and Nelveen identified them

facts.fact: 翡翠征兆：胸骨间绿光脉动黑纹蠕动——"你还没见识过我的能力的十分之一"
facts.anchor: the emerald embedded in her skin between her breasts, dark veins squirming beneath her reddened skin

facts.fact: 初见真相官宣：第一天就是奉命去收货——"但从林中初遇起我就是你的"
facts.anchor: I was there that day for you. I had already been given the assignment from Vasara, and I was there to collect

facts.fact: 承诺转折：客栈看她打得稀烂——"那时我知道我彻底下不了船了"
facts.anchor: Then I saw how shitty you are at fighting at the Traveler’s Inn, and I knew I was entirely committed.

facts.fact: 誓言升级：取出翡翠前不走——必要时跟你走一百万次天涯海角
facts.anchor: I will not leave you until we figure out a way to get that gods damned emerald out of your beautiful body

facts.fact: 全书末句：她说"你造出了无法想象的怪物""你不是怪物"——"也许我不是。但你是。"
facts.anchor: “You have no idea the monster you’ve created, Gerrick,” she whispered in the small space between them.
